dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim

WORKDIR /app

COPY requirements.txt .

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    gcc \
    g++ \
    libcairo2-dev \
    pkg-config \
    && pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt \
    && apt-get purge -y --auto-remove gcc g++ \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

COPY . .

CMD ["python", "your_main_script.py"]
explanation: Generated requirements.txt with pinned versions for stability in the VA.gov environment. Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim with Cairo dependencies for cairosvg, build tools for compiling native dependencies, and cleanup to minimize image size. Replace 'your_main_script.py' with actual entrypoint.
